description: Observation values for one series. Every value carries provenance (the exact source URL it came from, retrieval time, connector version) and the envelope carries the series verification status + citation. Defaults to the latest 60 points; use start/end (YYYY-MM-DD) or latest to control the window. Pass asOf for a point-in-time read: the values as Starwell's store held them on that date, before any later revision (available from the series' first ingest forward).

asOf.description: Point-in-time cutoff, YYYY-MM-DD (end of that UTC day) or an ISO 8601 instant: return what Starwell's store held then, ignoring later revisions

latest.description: Return only the latest N points (default 60 when no start/end given)

name: get_observations
title: Get observations (with provenance)
